name: process_tag
label: ITSM Module Tag Table
description: ITSM module tag table for querying, filtering, and reporting on process-related data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Tag name. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the name field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
